rule: These links associate an already-public product record with an already-public Machine Commerce offer. A link is evidence for review only and never grants new authority, payment rights, private access, or MCP publication.

links.evidence: Machine Commerce catalog exposes a human-auth handoff only. The CallProof app contains authenticated entitlement, checkout, and packet-consumption primitives, but no public agent execution contract is yet declared.
links.required_next_primitive: Define and externally prove an OAuth/user-authenticated MCP or bounded agent handoff that cannot read another user's records, file complaints, or create checkout without explicit human action.

links.evidence: EverMaps now has a committed, Deno-check-clean publicProjectionQuery candidate over explicitly public_safe, read_only projection entities. It supports bounded queries across climate/ocean fields, river history, observation platforms, navigation lights, heat/smoke action sites and access gaps, volcanic lakes, and aggregate lifeline coverage. Exact lifeline asset topology is deliberately excluded. Live deployment has not yet been independently verified, so EverMaps remains discovery-only.
links.required_next_primitive: Maintain external canary, source/data freshness, conformance and registry publication. Any authority expansion requires a new proof cycle.

links.evidence: GlobalStat now has a committed and Deno-check-clean read-only countryIntelligence candidate. It returns public evidence rows, source URLs, reconciliation findings, signals, methodology context and explicit coverage gaps while preserving missing-vs-zero and modeled-vs-observed boundaries. Live deployment has not yet been independently verified, so the product remains discovery-only.
links.required_next_primitive: Maintain external canary, source/data freshness, conformance and registry publication. Any authority expansion requires a new proof cycle.

links.evidence: Little Red now has a committed deterministic read-only KDP export-preflight candidate using caller-supplied page count, trim, cover geometry and pixel dimensions. It preserves KDP source URLs, does not assert variable maximum-page limits, and has no upload, publishing, checkout or payment authority. Live deployment has not yet been independently verified, so the product remains discovery-only.
links.required_next_primitive: Maintain external canary, source/data freshness, conformance and registry publication. Any authority expansion requires a new proof cycle.

links.evidence: Systemia Atlas publishes a machine-discovery contract for freight exception intelligence, but no public execution endpoint is currently declared.
links.required_next_primitive: Expose a tenant-authorized read-only exception summary endpoint with provenance and explicit unknowns; no dispatch, carrier contact, claim filing, invoice, or payment side effects.

links.evidence: Talent Atlas publishes machine discovery for evidence-backed profiles, but public execution remains discovery-only.
links.required_next_primitive: Expose a consent-scoped read-only evidence profile endpoint that uses supplied/authorized evidence only, does not infer protected traits, and cannot contact or apply on anyone's behalf.

links.evidence: TOWI now has a committed, Deno-check-clean evidencePacketAudit candidate that evaluates caller-supplied research evidence for provenance completeness, evidence-state mix, primary-source coverage, contradictions, modeled/disputed records and evidence-standard readiness. It performs no external research and makes no consequential recommendation. Live deployment has not yet been independently verified, so TOWI remains discovery-only.
links.required_next_primitive: Independently verify evidencePacketAudit in production, record conformance, then expose it through the existing Machine Commerce MCP as a read-only TOWI evidence-control tool. Keep actual external research, paid work, outreach and publication behind their existing gates.
